notes:
YLLW 0.5.6
- Browser mode: a new toolbar button, or Ctrl+Shift+F, turns YLLW into a regular browser. One page fills the window and the tools, console and device controls step aside. Press it again to get your devices and panels back as they were.
- Easier resize handles: on a picked element, the whole right and bottom edges resize it and the corner does both. Handles and the selection border stay the same size on screen at any zoom, and the resize cursor shows even with Touch on.
- Free layout zooms to fit your panes as tightly as it can each time you drop one, and panes no longer pile on each other when zoomed far out.
- The sync bar now stays in front of every pane in every layout.
- The tour covers Browser mode, the handles and the Free auto-zoom.
